faq.label: Questions & Answers
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AIVO.
faq.q1: What age range is AIVO designed for?
faq.a1: AIVO serves learners from pre-K through high school (ages 3-18). Our five functioning levels ensure that learners of all abilities, from gifted to pre-symbolic, get appropriately challenging content.
faq.q2: How does the Brain Clone work?
faq.a2: The Brain Clone is a personalized AI model that builds a detailed understanding of your child's learning patterns, strengths, and challenges. It adapts in real-time, adjusts across all 14 tutors simultaneously, and can be snapshotted or rolled back if needed.
faq.q3: Is AIVO appropriate for children with special needs?
faq.a3: Absolutely. AIVO was built from the ground up for inclusive education. We support AAC devices, switch access, eye-gaze technology, sensory profiles, and five functioning levels ranging from standard academics to pre-symbolic communication.
faq.q4: Can therapists and teachers access my child's data?
faq.a4: Yes, with your permission. Parents control who has access. Teachers, therapists, and caregivers can be invited to view progress, contribute to IEP goals, and collaborate on your child's learning team.
faq.a5: AIVO covers 14 domains through specialized AI tutors: Mathematics, English Language Arts, Science, History, Coding, Speech & Communication, Social-Emotional Learning, Geography, Music, Physical Education, World Languages, STEM & Engineering, Life Skills, and Creative Arts.
faq.q6: How does pricing work for schools and districts?
faq.a6: We offer volume licensing for schools and districts with dedicated onboarding, admin dashboards, IEP integration, and professional development support. Contact our education team for a custom quote.
faq.a7: We take data privacy seriously. AIVO is designed to support COPPA and FERPA, encrypts data in transit and at rest, and never sells or shares learner data. Parents have full control over data access and can request deletion at any time.
faq.q8: Can I try AIVO before committing?
faq.a8: Yes! Our Free Trial plan gives you access to 1 tutor and 1 learner profile. Paid plans come with a 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

home.hero_body: AIVO is the first AI learning platform engineered explicitly for neurodiverse cognitive profiles. We build a personalized brain-clone that models how your K-8 child learns best.
home.hero_image_alt: A child smiling while learning on a laptop with AIVO
home.philosophy_image_alt: A child learning on a tablet with the AIVO interface
home.philosophy_body: Most EdTech builds for the average student and patches on accessibility later. We started with the most complex cognitive profiles — autism, ADHD, sensory processing differences — and built an engine that dynamically scales to any mind.
home.philosophy_feature_tutors_desc: From highly-structured explicit instruction to open-ended exploratory dialog.
home.philosophy_feature_levels_desc: Content complexity decoupled from interface complexity.
home.philosophy_feature_sensory_desc: First-class controls for visual noise, contrast, and cognitive load.
home.testimonial_1_quote: My 8-year-old has profound ADHD and dyslexia. Every other app felt like a slot machine — too loud, too fast. AIVO is the first platform that slows down when he gets overwhelmed. It is not just a learning app, it is a regulated environment.
home.testimonial_2_quote: We use the Calm sensory mode exclusively. For an autistic learner, removing the visual clutter is not a nice-to-have, it is the difference between learning and melting down. The data tracking for his IEP is phenomenal.
home.cta_body: Start with a comprehensive baseline assessment. No credit card required for the first 14 days.
home.cta_image_alt: A parent and child learning together on a sofa
home.stat_focus_qualitative: Students show meaningful gains in focus and engagement
home.research_methodology_body: Our learning engine is grounded in published special-education research, Universal Design for Learning (UDL), and adaptive cognition science.
home.value_props_heading: Principles that put your child first.
home.value_props_subheading: AIVO is built on established learning science — not assumptions about what a typical student looks like.
home.value_prop_1_desc: Following UDL guidelines, we provide multiple means of engagement, representation, and action so every learner can access the curriculum.
home.value_prop_2_desc: Lessons follow explicit, sequential patterns that build knowledge step by step — an approach well-suited to learners with dyslexia, ADHD, and related profiles.
home.value_prop_3_desc: Learners control visual complexity, contrast, and pacing in real time — reducing sensory barriers to engagement rather than adding them.
